4	from __future__ import annotations

6	import json
7	import re
8	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
9	from pathlib import Path
10	from typing import Optional
11	
12	
13	@dataclass
14	class Step:
15	    """A single step in an agent trajectory."""
16	    index: int
17	    role: str  # "system", "user", or "ai"
18	    text: str
19	    mask: bool
20	    cutoff_date: Optional[str] = None
21	    system_prompt: Optional[str] = None
22	
23	    @property
24	    def is_action(self) -> bool:
25	        return self.role == "ai"
26	
27	    @property
28	    def is_observation(self) -> bool:
29	        return self.role == "user" and self.index > 0
30	
31	    @property
32	    def is_system(self) -> bool:
33	        return self.role == "system"
34	
35	    @property
36	    def command(self) -> Optional[str]:
37	        """Extract the command from an AI step's code block. Returns None for non-AI steps."""
38	        if self.role != "ai":
39	            return None
40	        match = re.search(r"```\n?(.*?)```", self.text, re.DOTALL)
41	        if match:
42	            return match.group(1).strip()
43	        return None
44	
45	    @property
46	    def has_file_display(self) -> bool:
47	        return "[File:" in self.text
48	
49	    @property
50	    def has_error(self) -> bool:
51	        return "Traceback" in self.text or "Error" in self.text
52	
53	    @property
54	    def has_test_output(self) -> bool:
55	        text = self.text
56	        return ("PASSED" in text or "FAILED" in text) and "test" in text.lower()
57	
58	
59	@dataclass
60	class TestResult:
61	    """Parsed test results from eval_logs."""
62	    passed: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
63	    failed: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
64	    errored: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
65	
66	    @property
67	    def total(self) -> int:
68	        return len(self.passed) + len(self.failed) + len(self.errored)
69	
70	    @property
71	    def pass_rate(self) -> float:
72	        if self.total == 0:
73	            return 0.0
74	        return len(self.passed) / self.total
75	
76	
77	@dataclass
78	class Trajectory:
79	    """A complete agent trajectory for one SWE-bench instance attempt."""
80	    instance_id: str
81	    model_name: str
82	    target: bool  # True = resolved, False = unresolved
83	    steps: list[Step]
84	    exit_status: str
85	    generated_patch: Optional[str]
86	    eval_logs: Optional[str]
87	
88	    @property
89	    def num_steps(self) -> int:
90	        return len(self.steps)
91	
92	    @property
93	    def actions(self) -> list[Step]:
94	        return [s for s in self.steps if s.is_action]
95	
96	    @property
97	    def observations(self) -> list[Step]:
98	        return [s for s in self.steps if s.is_observation]
99	
100	    @property
101	    def issue_text(self) -> Optional[str]:
102	        """The issue description from step 1 (first user message)."""
103	        if len(self.steps) > 1 and self.steps[1].role == "user":
104	            return self.steps[1].text
105	        return None
106	
107	    @property
108	    def has_patch(self) -> bool:
109	        return bool(self.generated_patch and self.generated_patch.strip())
110	
111	    def parse_eval_test_results(self) -> Optional[TestResult]:
112	        """Parse test results from eval_logs.
113	
114	        Returns:
115	            TestResult with lists of passed/failed/errored test names,
116	            or None if eval_logs is empty or has no test section.
117	        """
118	        if not self.eval_logs:
119	            return None
120	        start_marker = "___TESTS_SECTION___"
121	        end_marker = "___TESTS_SECTION_END"
122	        if start_marker not in self.eval_logs:
123	            return None
124	        start = self.eval_logs.index(start_marker)
125	        end = self.eval_logs.index(end_marker) if end_marker in self.eval_logs else len(self.eval_logs)
126	        section = self.eval_logs[start:end]
127	
128	        result = TestResult()
129	        for line in section.splitlines():
130	            line = line.strip()
131	            if line.startswith("PASSED "):
132	                result.passed.append(line[7:])
133	            elif line.startswith("FAILED "):
134	                name = line[7:].split(" - ")[0]
135	                result.failed.append(name)
136	            elif line.startswith("ERROR "):
137	                result.errored.append(line[6:])
138	        return result
139	
140	    def extract_mid_trajectory_test_results(self) -> list[tuple[int, TestResult]]:
141	        """Find pytest runs within the trajectory observations.
142	
143	        Returns:
144	            List of (step_index, TestResult) for steps containing pytest output.
145	        """
146	        results = []
147	        for step in self.observations:
148	            if not step.has_test_output:
149	                continue
150	            tr = TestResult()
151	            for line in step.text.splitlines():
152	                line = line.strip()
153	                if line.startswith("PASSED "):
154	                    tr.passed.append(line[7:])
155	                elif line.startswith("FAILED "):
156	                    name = line[7:].split(" - ")[0]
157	                    tr.failed.append(name)
158	                elif line.startswith("ERROR "):
159	                    tr.errored.append(line[6:])
160	            summary = re.search(r"(\d+) passed", step.text)
161	            if summary and not tr.passed:
162	                tr.passed = [f"unnamed_{i}" for i in range(int(summary.group(1)))]
163	            summary = re.search(r"(\d+) failed", step.text)
164	            if summary and not tr.failed:
165	                tr.failed = [f"unnamed_{i}" for i in range(int(summary.group(1)))]
166	            if tr.total > 0:
167	                results.append((step.index, tr))
168	        return results
169	
170	    def get_edit_commands(self) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
171	        """Extract all edit commands from the trajectory.
172	
173	        Returns:
174	            List of (step_index, command_text) for steps containing edit commands.
175	        """
176	        edits = []
177	        for step in self.actions:
178	            cmd = step.command
179	            if cmd and cmd.strip().startswith("edit"):
180	                edits.append((step.index, cmd))
181	        return edits
182	
183	
184	def parse_trajectory(raw: dict) -> Trajectory:
185	    """Parse a single raw record dict into a Trajectory object.
186	
187	    Args:
188	        raw: A dict with keys: instance_id, model_name, target, trajectory,
189	             exit_status, generated_patch, eval_logs.
190	
191	    Returns:
192	        A Trajectory object with parsed Steps.
193	    """
194	    steps = []
195	    for i, step_raw in enumerate(raw.get("trajectory") or []):
196	        steps.append(Step(
197	            index=i,
198	            role=step_raw.get("role", "unknown"),
199	            text=step_raw.get("text") or "",
200	            mask=step_raw.get("mask", False),
201	            cutoff_date=step_raw.get("cutoff_date"),
202	            system_prompt=step_raw.get("system_prompt"),
203	        ))
204	
205	    return Trajectory(
206	        instance_id=raw.get("instance_id", ""),
207	        model_name=raw.get("model_name", ""),
208	        target=raw.get("target", False),
209	        steps=steps,
210	        exit_status=raw.get("exit_status", ""),
211	        generated_patch=raw.get("generated_patch"),
212	        eval_logs=raw.get("eval_logs"),
213	    )
214	
215	
216	def extract_steps(trajectory: Trajectory) -> list[Step]:
217	    """Extract the step sequence from a trajectory, excluding the system step.
218	
219	    Args:
220	        trajectory: A parsed Trajectory object.
221	
222	    Returns:
223	        List of Steps starting from step 1 (the issue description),
224	        excluding the system prompt step.
225	    """
226	    return [s for s in trajectory.steps if not s.is_system]
227	
228	
229	def load_trajectories(path: str | Path) -> list[Trajectory]:
230	    """Load trajectories from a JSONL file.
231	
232	    Args:
233	        path: Path to a .jsonl file where each line is a JSON record.
234	
235	    Returns:
236	        List of Trajectory objects.
237	    """
238	    path = Path(path)
239	    trajectories = []
240	    with open(path) as f:
241	        for line in f:
242	            line = line.strip()
243	            if not line:
244	                continue
245	            raw = json.loads(line)
246	            trajectories.append(parse_trajectory(raw))
247	    return trajectories
248	
249	
250	def load_trajectories_streaming(path: str | Path, limit: int | None = None):
251	    """Lazily yield trajectories from a JSONL file.
252	
253	    Args:
254	        path: Path to a .jsonl file.
255	        limit: Maximum number of trajectories to yield. None for all.
256	
257	    Yields:
258	        Trajectory objects one at a time.
259	    """
260	    path = Path(path)
261	    count = 0
262	    with open(path) as f:
263	        for line in f:
264	            line = line.strip()
265	            if not line:
266	                continue
267	            raw = json.loads(line)
268	            yield parse_trajectory(raw)
269	            count += 1
270	            if limit and count >= limit:
271	                break
272

278	        "agent_progress_probe/artifacts/data/swe_agent_trajectories_1000.jsonl"

282	    trajs = load_trajectories(data_path)
283	    print(f"Loaded {len(trajs)} trajectories")

294	    test_result = t.parse_eval_test_results()
295	    if test_result:
296	        print(f"  Eval tests: {len(test_result.passed)} passed, {len(test_result.failed)} failed, pass_rate={test_result.pass_rate:.2f}")
297	
298	    edits = t.get_edit_commands()
299	    print(f"  Edit commands: {len(edits)}")

1	# SWE-agent Trajectories 数据格式报告
2	
3	## 1. 数据集概况
4	
5	| 属性 | 值 |
6	|------|-----|
7	| HuggingFace ID | `nebius/SWE-agent-trajectories` |
8	| Splits | `train` (仅一个) |
9	| 总记录数 | 80,036 条轨迹 |
10	| 唯一 instance_id | 3,591 个（同一问题有多个 agent 尝试） |
11	| Resolved (target=True) | 13,389 (16.7%) |
12	| Unresolved (target=False) | 66,647 (83.3%) |
13	| 模型分布 | llama-70b: 74,792 / llama-8b: 4,053 / llama-405b: 1,191 |
14	| 子集文件 | `artifacts/data/swe_agent_trajectories_1000.jsonl` (68.4 MB, 1000条) |
15	
16	## 2. 顶层字段
17	
18	每条记录包含 **7 个字段**：
19	
20	| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
21	|------|------|------|
22	| `instance_id` | `str` | SWE-bench 问题 ID，格式 `{repo_owner}__{repo}-{issue_number}`，如 `AnalogJ__lexicon-336` |
23	| `model_name` | `str` | 使用的模型，`swe-agent-llama-70b` / `swe-agent-llama-8b` / `swe-agent-llama-405b` |
24	| `target` | `bool` | **最终是否解决了问题**。`True` = resolved，`False` = unresolved |
25	| `trajectory` | `list[dict]` | 交互轨迹序列，每个元素是一个 step（见下文） |
26	| `exit_status` | `str` | 退出状态：`submitted` (74%) / `submitted (exit_context)` (24%) / `exit_context` (2%) |
27	| `generated_patch` | `str` 或 `None` | agent 生成的最终 diff patch（unified diff 格式），7% 为空 |
28	| `eval_logs` | `str` 或 `None` | SWE-bench 评估日志（含 patch apply + 测试运行结果），7% 为空 |
29	
30	## 3. 轨迹序列结构 (`trajectory`)
31	
32	### 3.1 Step 字段
33	
34	每个 step 是一个 dict，包含 **5 个固定字段**：
35	
36	| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
37	|------|------|------|
38	| `role` | `str` | `system` / `user` / `ai` |
39	| `text` | `str` 或 `None` | step 的文本内容（action 或 observation） |
40	| `mask` | `bool` | `True` 表示该 step 是 AI 生成的（`ai` role 始终为 True） |
41	| `cutoff_date` | `str` 或 `None` | 仅 system step 有值（如 `01.01.2023`），其余为 None |
42	| `system_prompt` | `str` 或 `None` | 仅 system step 有值（SWE-agent 的系统提示词，~4873 chars），其余为 None |
43	
44	### 3.2 轨迹模式
45	
46	一条轨迹的 role 序列始终为：
47	
48	```
49	system → user → ai → user → ai → user → ai → ... → ai
50	```
51	
52	- **Step 0** (`system`): 系统提示词，`text` 为空/None，实际内容在 `system_prompt` 字段
53	- **Step 1** (`user`): Issue 描述 + 指令，格式为 "We're currently solving the following issue... ISSUE: ... INSTRUCTIONS: ..."
54	- **Step 2+** (`ai` / `user` 交替): agent action 和环境 observation 交替出现
55	
56	### 3.3 轨迹长度统计（1000 条子集）
57	
58	| 指标 | 值 |
59	|------|-----|
60	| 最短 | 3 steps |
61	| 最长 | 699 steps |
62	| 中位数 | 35 steps |
63	| 平均值 | 55.3 steps |
64	| Step 文本平均长度 | ~1,102 chars |
65	| Step 文本最大长度 | ~16,000 chars |
66	
67	### 3.4 AI Step (Action) 格式
68	
69	AI step 的 `text` 包含两部分：
70	1. **思考/推理文本**（自然语言）
71	2. **命令**（包裹在 ``` 代码块中）
72	
73	示例：
74	```
75	To start solving this issue, we need to reproduce the error first.
76	
77	\```
78	lexicon memset create example.com TXT --name _acme-challenge.example.com --content BLAH --ttl 300
79	\```
80	```
81	
82	常见命令类型：
83	- `open <path>` / `goto <line>` / `scroll_down` / `scroll_up` — 文件导航
84	- `edit <start>:<end>\n<content>\nend_of_edit` — 编辑文件
85	- `search_dir <term>` / `search_file <term>` — 搜索
86	- `find_file <name>` — 查找文件
87	- `submit` — 提交最终修改
88	- 标准 bash 命令（`ls`, `cat`, `python`, `pytest` 等）
89	
90	**100% 的 AI step 都包含代码块**（命令是通过代码块传递的）。
91	
92	### 3.5 User Step (Observation) 格式
93	
94	User step 的 `text` 是环境返回的 observation，常见格式：
95	
96	- **文件内容显示**: `[File: /path/to/file.py (N lines total)]` 后跟带行号的代码
97	- **命令输出**: 标准 stdout/stderr 输出
98	- **错误信息**: Python traceback, 编译错误等
99	- **状态行**: `(Open file: /path) (Current directory: /repo) bash-$`
100	
101	34% 的 observation 包含 `[File:` 文件显示，25% 包含错误信息，100% 以 `bash-$` 结尾。
102	
103	## 4. 标签信息
104	
105	### 4.1 Resolved/Unresolved 标签
106	
107	- **字段**: `target` (bool)
108	- **True** = 问题成功解决（通过 SWE-bench 评估验证）
109	- **False** = 未解决
110	- **分布**: 16.7% resolved / 83.3% unresolved
111	
112	### 4.2 Exit Status
113	
114	| 状态 | 含义 | 占比 |
115	|------|------|------|
116	| `submitted` | agent 正常提交 patch | ~74% |
117	| `submitted (exit_context)` | agent 超出上下文窗口后被强制提交 | ~24% |
118	| `exit_context` | agent 超出上下文但未提交 | ~2% |
119	
120	## 5. 中间产物
121	
122	### 5.1 生成的 Patch (`generated_patch`)
123	
124	- 标准 unified diff 格式（`diff --git a/... b/...`）
125	- 可以直接用 `git apply` 应用
126	- 平均长度 ~1,392 chars，最大 ~16,126 chars
127	- 7% 为空（agent 未成功生成 patch）
128	
129	### 5.2 评估日志 (`eval_logs`)
130	
131	包含 SWE-bench 的完整评估流程，结构化为几个阶段：
132	
133	```
134	1. Apply prediction patch:  "git apply -v /swebench_matterhorn/prediction_patch.patch"
135	2. Apply test patch:        "git apply -v /swebench_matterhorn/test_patch.patch"
136	3. ___ENVIRONMENT_SET_UP_PATCH_APPLIED___
137	4. Run tests:               "pytest --no-header -rA --tb=no ..."
138	5. ___TESTS_SECTION___
139	   ... pytest 输出（PASSED/FAILED 列表）...
140	   ___TESTS_SECTION_END
141	```
142	
143	**测试结果解析方法**：
144	- 定位 `___TESTS_SECTION___` 和 `___TESTS_SECTION_END` 之间的文本
145	- 每行 `PASSED tests/...` 或 `FAILED tests/...` 表示单个测试结果
146	- 最终汇总行如 `5 failed in 0.54s` 或 `20 passed in 1.2s`
147	
148	### 5.3 轨迹内的测试运行
149	
150	agent 在轨迹中间也可能运行 `pytest`，输出出现在 `user` step 的 observation 中。格式与标准 pytest 输出一致，但**不带 `___TESTS_SECTION___` 标记**。
151	
152	### 5.4 文件修改（在轨迹中）
153	
154	agent 使用 `edit` 命令修改文件，下一个 observation 会显示修改后的文件内容。可以通过追踪所有 `edit` 命令来重建文件修改历史。最终的完整 diff 在 `generated_patch` 字段中。
155	
156	### 5.5 没有的信号
157	
158	- **无 linter 输出**：除非 agent 主动运行 linter
159	- **无结构化 code quality 指标**
160	- **无中间 checkpoint/状态快照**
161	
162	## 6. 对 Labeling Function 实现的影响
163	
164	### 6.1 `file_diff_delta` — 代码变更信号
165	
166	**主数据源**: `generated_patch` 字段
167	- 直接可用的 unified diff 格式
168	- 可解析出：修改的文件列表、添加/删除行数、涉及的函数/类
169	
170	**辅助数据源**: 轨迹中的 `edit` 命令
171	- 可以在每个 step 级别追踪代码变更的增量
172	- 需要解析 AI step 中的 `edit <start>:<end>` 命令格式
173	
174	### 6.2 `test_pass_rate_transition` — 测试结果转变
175	
176	**主数据源**: `eval_logs` 字段
177	- 解析 `___TESTS_SECTION___` ... `___TESTS_SECTION_END` 区间
178	- 提取 PASSED/FAILED 计数
179	- 这是**最终**测试结果（agent 提交后的评估）
180	
181	**辅助数据源**: 轨迹内的 pytest 输出
182	- agent 可能在轨迹中间运行测试（出现在 `user` step 中）
183	- 可以追踪测试通过率随时间的变化（transition）
184	- 需要用正则匹配 pytest 输出格式：`N passed`, `N failed`, `PASSED`, `FAILED`
185	
186	**注意**: 不是所有轨迹都有中间测试运行，取决于 agent 的行为策略。
187	
188	### 6.3 `outcome_backpropagation` — 结果回传
189	
190	**数据源**: `target` 字段（bool）
191	- 直接获取，无需解析
192	- `True` = resolved，可以作为正样本
193	- `False` = unresolved，负样本
194	
195	**增强信号**:
196	- `exit_status` 可区分 "正常提交但失败" vs "超时/上下文溢出"
197	- `eval_logs` 中的测试结果可提供更细粒度的"接近成功"信号（如 5 个测试通过了 4 个）
198	
199	## 7. 数据质量观察
200	
201	1. **同一 instance 多次尝试**: 80,036 条轨迹对应 3,591 个唯一问题，平均每个问题 ~22 次尝试。建议按 `instance_id` 分组分析。
202	2. **模型不均衡**: 93.5% 是 llama-70b 的轨迹，8b 和 405b 样本较少。
203	3. **空值处理**: `generated_patch` 和 `eval_logs` 各有 ~7% 为空，需要在处理时跳过。
204	4. **text 字段 None**: system step 的 `text` 为 None（内容在 `system_prompt` 中），以及少数异常 step 的 `text` 可能为 None。
205	5. **轨迹长度差异极大**: 3 到 699 步，长轨迹可能对应 context overflow 的情况。
206	6. **子集前 1000 条是按 instance_id 排序的**，前 11 条都是同一个 issue (AnalogJ__lexicon-336)，数据分布并非随机。后续分析建议 shuffle 或按 instance_id 采样。

# SWE-agent Trajectories 数据格式报告

## 1. 数据集概况

| 属性 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| HuggingFace ID | `nebius/SWE-agent-trajectories` |
| Splits | `train` (仅一个) |
| 总记录数 | 80,036 条轨迹 |
| 唯一 instance_id | 3,591 个（同一问题有多个 agent 尝试） |
| Resolved (target=True) | 13,389 (16.7%) |
| Unresolved (target=False) | 66,647 (83.3%) |
| 模型分布 | llama-70b: 74,792 / llama-8b: 4,053 / llama-405b: 1,191 |
| 子集文件 | `artifacts/data/swe_agent_trajectories_1000.jsonl` (68.4 MB, 1000条) |

## 2. 顶层字段

每条记录包含 **7 个字段**：

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `instance_id` | `str` | SWE-bench 问题 ID，格式 `{repo_owner}__{repo}-{issue_number}`，如 `AnalogJ__lexicon-336` |
| `model_name` | `str` | 使用的模型，`swe-agent-llama-70b` / `swe-agent-llama-8b` / `swe-agent-llama-405b` |
| `target` | `bool` | **最终是否解决了问题**。`True` = resolved，`False` = unresolved |
| `trajectory` | `list[dict]` | 交互轨迹序列，每个元素是一个 step（见下文） |
| `exit_status` | `str` | 退出状态：`submitted` (74%) / `submitted (exit_context)` (24%) / `exit_context` (2%) |
| `generated_patch` | `str` 或 `None` | agent 生成的最终 diff patch（unified diff 格式），7% 为空 |
| `eval_logs` | `str` 或 `None` | SWE-bench 评估日志（含 patch apply + 测试运行结果），7% 为空 |

## 3. 轨迹序列结构 (`trajectory`)

### 3.1 Step 字段

每个 step 是一个 dict，包含 **5 个固定字段**：

| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `role` | `str` | `system` / `user` / `ai` |
| `text` | `str` 或 `None` | step 的文本内容（action 或 observation） |
| `mask` | `bool` | `True` 表示该 step 是 AI 生成的（`ai` role 始终为 True） |
| `cutoff_date` | `str` 或 `None` | 仅 system step 有值（如 `01.01.2023`），其余为 None |
| `system_prompt` | `str` 或 `None` | 仅 system step 有值（SWE-agent 的系统提示词，~4873 chars），其余为 None |

### 3.2 轨迹模式

一条轨迹的 role 序列始终为：

```
system → user → ai → user → ai → user → ai → ... → ai
```

- **Step 0** (`system`): 系统提示词，`text` 为空/None，实际内容在 `system_prompt` 字段
- **Step 1** (`user`): Issue 描述 + 指令，格式为 "We're currently solving the following issue... ISSUE: ... INSTRUCTIONS: ..."
- **Step 2+** (`ai` / `user` 交替): agent action 和环境 observation 交替出现

### 3.3 轨迹长度统计（1000 条子集）

| 指标 | 值 |
|------|-----|
| 最短 | 3 steps |
| 最长 | 699 steps |
| 中位数 | 35 steps |
| 平均值 | 55.3 steps |
| Step 文本平均长度 | ~1,102 chars |
| Step 文本最大长度 | ~16,000 chars |

### 3.4 AI Step (Action) 格式

AI step 的 `text` 包含两部分：
1. **思考/推理文本**（自然语言）
2. **命令**（包裹在 ``` 代码块中）

示例：
```
To start solving this issue, we need to reproduce the error first.

\```
lexicon memset create example.com TXT --name _acme-challenge.example.com --content BLAH --ttl 300
\```
```

常见命令类型：
- `open <path>` / `goto <line>` / `scroll_down` / `scroll_up` — 文件导航
- `edit <start>:<end>\n<content>\nend_of_edit` — 编辑文件
- `search_dir <term>` / `search_file <term>` — 搜索
- `find_file <name>` — 查找文件
- `submit` — 提交最终修改
- 标准 bash 命令（`ls`, `cat`, `python`, `pytest` 等）

**100% 的 AI step 都包含代码块**（命令是通过代码块传递的）。

### 3.5 User Step (Observation) 格式

User step 的 `text` 是环境返回的 observation，常见格式：

- **文件内容显示**: `[File: /path/to/file.py (N lines total)]` 后跟带行号的代码
- **命令输出**: 标准 stdout/stderr 输出
- **错误信息**: Python traceback, 编译错误等
- **状态行**: `(Open file: /path) (Current directory: /repo) bash-$`

34% 的 observation 包含 `[File:` 文件显示，25% 包含错误信息，100% 以 `bash-$` 结尾。

## 4. 标签信息

### 4.1 Resolved/Unresolved 标签

- **字段**: `target` (bool)
- **True** = 问题成功解决（通过 SWE-bench 评估验证）
- **False** = 未解决
- **分布**: 16.7% resolved / 83.3% unresolved

### 4.2 Exit Status

| 状态 | 含义 | 占比 |
|------|------|------|
| `submitted` | agent 正常提交 patch | ~74% |
| `submitted (exit_context)` | agent 超出上下文窗口后被强制提交 | ~24% |
| `exit_context` | agent 超出上下文但未提交 | ~2% |

## 5. 中间产物

### 5.1 生成的 Patch (`generated_patch`)

- 标准 unified diff 格式（`diff --git a/... b/...`）
- 可以直接用 `git apply` 应用
- 平均长度 ~1,392 chars，最大 ~16,126 chars
- 7% 为空（agent 未成功生成 patch）

### 5.2 评估日志 (`eval_logs`)

包含 SWE-bench 的完整评估流程，结构化为几个阶段：

```
1. Apply prediction patch:  "git apply -v /swebench_matterhorn/prediction_patch.patch"
2. Apply test patch:        "git apply -v /swebench_matterhorn/test_patch.patch"
3. ___ENVIRONMENT_SET_UP_PATCH_APPLIED___
4. Run tests:               "pytest --no-header -rA --tb=no ..."
5. ___TESTS_SECTION___
   ... pytest 输出（PASSED/FAILED 列表）...
   ___TESTS_SECTION_END
```

**测试结果解析方法**：
- 定位 `___TESTS_SECTION___` 和 `___TESTS_SECTION_END` 之间的文本
- 每行 `PASSED tests/...` 或 `FAILED tests/...` 表示单个测试结果
- 最终汇总行如 `5 failed in 0.54s` 或 `20 passed in 1.2s`

### 5.3 轨迹内的测试运行

agent 在轨迹中间也可能运行 `pytest`，输出出现在 `user` step 的 observation 中。格式与标准 pytest 输出一致，但**不带 `___TESTS_SECTION___` 标记**。

### 5.4 文件修改（在轨迹中）

agent 使用 `edit` 命令修改文件，下一个 observation 会显示修改后的文件内容。可以通过追踪所有 `edit` 命令来重建文件修改历史。最终的完整 diff 在 `generated_patch` 字段中。

### 5.5 没有的信号

- **无 linter 输出**：除非 agent 主动运行 linter
- **无结构化 code quality 指标**
- **无中间 checkpoint/状态快照**

## 6. 对 Labeling Function 实现的影响

### 6.1 `file_diff_delta` — 代码变更信号

**主数据源**: `generated_patch` 字段
- 直接可用的 unified diff 格式
- 可解析出：修改的文件列表、添加/删除行数、涉及的函数/类

**辅助数据源**: 轨迹中的 `edit` 命令
- 可以在每个 step 级别追踪代码变更的增量
- 需要解析 AI step 中的 `edit <start>:<end>` 命令格式

### 6.2 `test_pass_rate_transition` — 测试结果转变

**主数据源**: `eval_logs` 字段
- 解析 `___TESTS_SECTION___` ... `___TESTS_SECTION_END` 区间
- 提取 PASSED/FAILED 计数
- 这是**最终**测试结果（agent 提交后的评估）

**辅助数据源**: 轨迹内的 pytest 输出
- agent 可能在轨迹中间运行测试（出现在 `user` step 中）
- 可以追踪测试通过率随时间的变化（transition）
- 需要用正则匹配 pytest 输出格式：`N passed`, `N failed`, `PASSED`, `FAILED`

**注意**: 不是所有轨迹都有中间测试运行，取决于 agent 的行为策略。

### 6.3 `outcome_backpropagation` — 结果回传

**数据源**: `target` 字段（bool）
- 直接获取，无需解析
- `True` = resolved，可以作为正样本
- `False` = unresolved，负样本

**增强信号**:
- `exit_status` 可区分 "正常提交但失败" vs "超时/上下文溢出"
- `eval_logs` 中的测试结果可提供更细粒度的"接近成功"信号（如 5 个测试通过了 4 个）

## 7. 数据质量观察

1. **同一 instance 多次尝试**: 80,036 条轨迹对应 3,591 个唯一问题，平均每个问题 ~22 次尝试。建议按 `instance_id` 分组分析。
2. **模型不均衡**: 93.5% 是 llama-70b 的轨迹，8b 和 405b 样本较少。
3. **空值处理**: `generated_patch` 和 `eval_logs` 各有 ~7% 为空，需要在处理时跳过。
4. **text 字段 None**: system step 的 `text` 为 None（内容在 `system_prompt` 中），以及少数异常 step 的 `text` 可能为 None。
5. **轨迹长度差异极大**: 3 到 699 步，长轨迹可能对应 context overflow 的情况。
6. **子集前 1000 条是按 instance_id 排序的**，前 11 条都是同一个 issue (AnalogJ__lexicon-336)，数据分布并非随机。后续分析建议 shuffle 或按 instance_id 采样。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate step embeddings for labeled windows using Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B.

Expected windows_labeled.jsonl format (one JSON per line):
    {"window_id": str, "instance_id": str, "model_name": str,
     "step_indices": [int, ...], "label": int (0=stagnation, 1=progress), ...}

Requires the original trajectories JSONL to retrieve step texts.

Output: embeddings.pt containing per-window embedding tensors + metadata.
"""

import argparse
import json
from collections import defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
from tqdm import tqdm
from transformers import AutoModel, AutoTokenizer


def last_token_pool(last_hidden_states: torch.Tensor, attention_mask: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    left_padding = attention_mask[:, -1].sum() == attention_mask.shape[0]
    if left_padding:
        return last_hidden_states[:, -1]
    seq_lengths = attention_mask.sum(dim=1) - 1
    batch_idx = torch.arange(last_hidden_states.shape[0], device=last_hidden_states.device)
    return last_hidden_states[batch_idx, seq_lengths]


def build_trajectory_index(traj_path: str) -> dict:
    """Map (instance_id, model_name) -> list of step dicts with role and text."""
    index = {}
    with open(traj_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line:
                continue
            raw = json.loads(line)
            key = (raw["instance_id"], raw.get("model_name", ""))
            steps = []
            for s in raw.get("trajectory") or []:
                steps.append({
                    "role": s.get("role", "unknown"),
                    "text": s.get("text") or s.get("system_prompt") or "",
                })
            index[key] = steps
    return index


def load_windows(path: str) -> list[dict]:
    windows = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if line:
                windows.append(json.loads(line))
    return windows


@torch.no_grad()
def encode_texts(
    texts: list[str], model, tokenizer, batch_size: int, max_length: int, device: str
) -> torch.Tensor:
    all_embeds = []
    for i in range(0, len(texts), batch_size):
        batch = texts[i : i + batch_size]
        encoded = tokenizer(
            batch, max_length=max_length, padding=True, truncation=True, return_tensors="pt"
        ).to(device)
        outputs = model(**encoded)
        embeds = last_token_pool(outputs.last_hidden_state, encoded["attention_mask"])
        embeds = F.normalize(embeds, p=2, dim=1)
        all_embeds.append(embeds.cpu())
    return torch.cat(all_embeds, dim=0)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Generate step embeddings using Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B")
    parser.add_argument("--windows", required=True, help="Path to windows_labeled.jsonl")
    parser.add_argument("--trajectories", required=True, help="Path to original trajectories JSONL")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, help="Output .pt file path")
    parser.add_argument("--model_name", default="Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B")
    parser.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=64, help="Texts per encoding batch")
    parser.add_argument("--max_length", type=int, default=512, help="Max tokens per step text")
    parser.add_argument("--device", default=None, help="Device (auto-detect if unset)")
    parser.add_argument("--chunk_size", type=int, default=500, help="Windows per checkpoint chunk")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    output_path = Path(args.output)
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    checkpoint_path = output_path.with_suffix(".ckpt.pt")
    device = args.device or ("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    # Resume
    start_idx = 0
    results = {"embeddings": [], "labels": [], "window_ids": [], "instance_ids": [], "step_indices_list": []}
    if checkpoint_path.exists():
        ckpt = torch.load(checkpoint_path, weights_only=False)
        results = ckpt["results"]
        start_idx = ckpt["next_idx"]
        print(f"Resumed from checkpoint: {start_idx} windows done")

    # Load model
    print(f"Loading {args.model_name} ...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name, trust_remote_code=True)
    tokenizer.padding_side = "right"
    model = (
        AutoModel.from_pretrained(args.model_name, trust_remote_code=True, torch_dtype=torch.float16)
        .to(device)
        .eval()
    )
    embed_dim = model.config.hidden_size
    print(f"embed_dim={embed_dim}, device={device}")

    # Load data
    print("Building trajectory index ...")
    traj_index = build_trajectory_index(args.trajectories)
    print(f"Indexed {len(traj_index)} trajectories")

    windows = load_windows(args.windows)
    print(f"Total windows: {len(windows)}, pending: {len(windows) - start_idx}")

    if start_idx >= len(windows):
        print("All windows already processed.")
        return

    pbar = tqdm(total=len(windows), initial=start_idx, desc="Embedding")

    for chunk_start in range(start_idx, len(windows), args.chunk_size):
        chunk_end = min(chunk_start + args.chunk_size, len(windows))
        chunk = windows[chunk_start:chunk_end]

        # Collect all step texts in this chunk
        all_texts = []
        text_map = []  # (window_idx_in_chunk, step_position)
        for ci, w in enumerate(chunk):
            key = (w["instance_id"], w.get("model_name", ""))
            steps = traj_index.get(key, [])
            for si, step_idx in enumerate(w["step_indices"]):
                text = steps[step_idx]["text"] if step_idx < len(steps) else ""
                all_texts.append(text if text else "[empty]")
                text_map.append((ci, si))

        # Batch encode
        if all_texts:
            all_embeds = encode_texts(all_texts, model, tokenizer, args.batch_size, args.max_length, device)
        else:
            all_embeds = torch.zeros(0, embed_dim)

        # Reassemble per window
        window_positions = defaultdict(list)
        for pos, (ci, si) in enumerate(text_map):
            window_positions[ci].append((si, pos))

        for ci, w in enumerate(chunk):
            positions = sorted(window_positions.get(ci, []), key=lambda x: x[0])
            if positions:
                window_tensor = torch.stack([all_embeds[pos] for _, pos in positions])
            else:
                window_tensor = torch.zeros(1, embed_dim)

            results["embeddings"].append(window_tensor)
            results["labels"].append(w["label"])
            results["window_ids"].append(w["window_id"])
            results["instance_ids"].append(w["instance_id"])
            results["step_indices_list"].append(w["step_indices"])

        pbar.update(len(chunk))

        # Checkpoint
        torch.save({"results": results, "next_idx": chunk_end}, checkpoint_path)

    pbar.close()

    # Save final output
    torch.save(
        {
            "embeddings": results["embeddings"],
            "labels": results["labels"],
            "window_ids": results["window_ids"],
            "instance_ids": results["instance_ids"],
            "step_indices_list": results["step_indices_list"],
            "embed_dim": embed_dim,
        },
        output_path,
    )
    print(f"Saved {len(results['embeddings'])} window embeddings to {output_path}")

    if checkpoint_path.exists():
        checkpoint_path.unlink()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Train the GRU progress probe on pre-computed window embeddings."""

import argparse
import json
import random
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score, precision_score, recall_score
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))
from probe_model import ProgressProbe, WindowDataset, collate_fn, split_by_instance


def set_seed(seed: int):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


def compute_metrics(labels: list[int], preds: list[int]) -> dict:
    return {
        "macro_f1": f1_score(labels, preds, average="macro", zero_division=0),
        "accuracy": accuracy_score(labels, preds),
        "precision_macro": precision_score(labels, preds, average="macro", zero_division=0),
        "recall_macro": recall_score(labels, preds, average="macro", zero_division=0),
        "f1_stagnation": f1_score(labels, preds, pos_label=0, zero_division=0),
        "f1_progress": f1_score(labels, preds, pos_label=1, zero_division=0),
    }


class EarlyStopping:
    def __init__(self, patience: int = 5):
        self.patience = patience
        self.counter = 0
        self.best_score = None
        self.should_stop = False

    def step(self, score: float) -> bool:
        if self.best_score is None or score > self.best_score:
            self.best_score = score
            self.counter = 0
            return True
        self.counter += 1
        if self.counter >= self.patience:
            self.should_stop = True
        return False


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate_epoch(model: nn.Module, loader: DataLoader, device: str) -> dict:
    model.eval()
    all_labels, all_preds = [], []
    for padded, labels, lengths in loader:
        logits = model(padded.to(device), lengths)
        preds = (torch.sigmoid(logits) >= 0.5).long().cpu()
        all_labels.extend(labels.long().tolist())
        all_preds.extend(preds.tolist())
    return compute_metrics(all_labels, all_preds)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Train GRU progress probe")
    parser.add_argument("--data_dir", required=True, help="Directory containing embeddings.pt")
    parser.add_argument("--output_dir", required=True, help="Output directory for checkpoints")
    parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=1e-3)
    parser.add_argument("--batch_size", type=int, default=32)
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=20)
    parser.add_argument("--hidden_size", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--num_layers", type=int, default=2)
    parser.add_argument("--dropout", type=float, default=0.1)
    parser.add_argument("--weight_decay", type=float, default=0.01)
    parser.add_argument("--patience", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    parser.add_argument("--wandb", action="store_true", help="Enable W&B logging")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    set_seed(args.seed)
    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"

    # Load data
    data_path = Path(args.data_dir) / "embeddings.pt"
    data = torch.load(data_path, weights_only=False)
    embeddings = data["embeddings"]
    labels = data["labels"]
    instance_ids = data["instance_ids"]
    embed_dim = data["embed_dim"]

    split_info = {
        "train_indices": train_idx,
        "val_indices": val_idx,
        "test_indices": test_idx,
        "seed": args.seed,
        "embed_dim": embed_dim,
    }
    with open(output_dir / "split_info.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(split_info, f)

    def make_dataset(indices):
        return WindowDataset([embeddings[i] for i in indices], [labels[i] for i in indices])

    train_ds = make_dataset(train_idx)
    val_ds = make_dataset(val_idx)

    train_labels = [labels[i] for i in train_idx]
    num_pos = sum(train_labels)
    num_neg = len(train_labels) - num_pos
    pos_weight = torch.tensor([num_neg / max(num_pos, 1)]).to(device)

    print(f"Train: {len(train_ds)} (pos={num_pos}, neg={num_neg})")
    print(f"Val:   {len(val_ds)}")
    print(f"Test:  {len(test_idx)}")
    print(f"pos_weight: {pos_weight.item():.3f}")

    train_loader = DataLoader(train_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    val_loader = DataLoader(val_ds, batch_size=args.batch_size, collate_fn=collate_fn)

        embed_dim=embed_dim,
        hidden_size=args.hidden_size,
        num_layers=args.num_layers,
        dropout=args.dropout,
    ).to(device)

    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=args.lr, weight_decay=args.weight_decay)
    criterion = nn.BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight=pos_weight)
    early_stopping = EarlyStopping(patience=args.patience)

    # W&B
    if args.wandb:
        import wandb

        wandb.init(project="agent-progress-probe", config=vars(args))

    # Training loop
    history = []
    for epoch in range(1, args.epochs + 1):
        model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        n_samples = 0
        for padded, batch_labels, lengths in train_loader:
            padded = padded.to(device)
            batch_labels = batch_labels.to(device)

            logits = model(padded, lengths)
            loss = criterion(logits, batch_labels)

            optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optimizer.step()

            total_loss += loss.item() * len(batch_labels)
            n_samples += len(batch_labels)

        avg_loss = total_loss / n_samples
        val_metrics = evaluate_epoch(model, val_loader, device)

        record = {"epoch": epoch, "train_loss": avg_loss, **{f"val_{k}": v for k, v in val_metrics.items()}}
        history.append(record)

        is_best = early_stopping.step(val_metrics["macro_f1"])
        marker = " *" if is_best else ""
        print(
            f"Epoch {epoch:2d} | loss={avg_loss:.4f} | "
            f"val_F1={val_metrics['macro_f1']:.4f} "
            f"acc={val_metrics['accuracy']:.4f}{marker}"
        )

                    "hidden_size": args.hidden_size,
                    "num_layers": args.num_layers,
                    "dropout": args.dropout,

            )

        if args.wandb:
            import wandb

            wandb.log(record)

        if early_stopping.should_stop:
            print(f"Early stopping at epoch {epoch}")
            break

    # Save history
    with open(output_dir / "train_history.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(history, f, indent=2)

    print(f"\nBest val macro-F1: {early_stopping.best_score:.4f}")
    print(f"Outputs saved to {output_dir}")

    main()
